title: Solution strengthening of ductile refractory HfMoxNbTaTiZr high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible under argon atmosphere. All raw elemental materials had purities higher than 99.9 wt%. A melting procedure was repeated at least five times to improve the chemical homogeneity of alloys.
